content.text: {"verdict":"pass","reasons":["Claimed status is 'compliant' and the cited text supports it: the quoted Personnel paragraphs (p0182/p0184) address only supervision, assignment and subcontracting, and p0200 ('Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others') is a freedom-of-action clause, not a restrictive covenant — none of the detection triggers ('shall not solicit', 'employ or engage', 'no-hire', 'induce ... to leave') appear.","Absence of any non-solicit binding the Customer matches the rule's preferred position, so no redline or counterparty comment is expected or required; the rendered redline is correctly identical to the originals and no comment was added.","The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are artifacts of there being no non-solicit clause to measure; they do not indicate a defect in this finding.","Minor, non-substantive: the rationale names the customer as 'Bluefly' while the quoted text references IBM as vendor — consistent with our side being the customer, so it does not affect the verdict."]}

reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and the cited text supports it: the quoted Personnel paragraphs (p0182/p0184) address only supervision, assignment and subcontracting, and p0200 ('Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others') is a freedom-of-action clause, not a restrictive covenant — none of the detection triggers ('shall not solicit', 'employ or engage', 'no-hire', 'induce ... to leave') appear.

Absence of any non-solicit binding the Customer matches the rule's preferred position, so no redline or counterparty comment is expected or required; the rendered redline is correctly identical to the originals and no comment was added.
The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are artifacts of there being no non-solicit clause to measure; they do not indicate a defect in this finding.
Minor, non-substantive: the rationale names the customer as 'Bluefly' while the quoted text references IBM as vendor — consistent with our side being the customer, so it does not affect the verdict.
